The most recent matter we've handled for Cascade Retail Holdings is **matter 1038-00003** — the **Universal Shelf Registration Statement on Form S-3**.

**What it's about:** Calderwood & Harkness was engaged as issuer's counsel to prepare and file a new universal shelf registration statement on Form S-3 with the SEC. The registration statement will cover up to **$3 billion** in aggregate offering amount of securities (common stock, preferred stock, debt securities, depositary shares, warrants, subscription rights, purchase contracts, and units). Cascade qualifies as a "well-known seasoned issuer" (WKSI), so the registration is expected to become effective automatically upon filing. The new shelf replaces the company's existing shelf (File No. 333-248710), which expires June 28, 2026. The target SEC filing date is May 26, 2026.

**When we opened it:** The engagement letter is dated **April 9, 2026**, and the kick-off call was held April 14, 2026.

This is the most recent matter for Cascade Retail Holdings — all other matters (the FTC merger challenge, the ABL credit facility, the Washington AG inquiry, the governance review, the Rathore litigation, the Vantor litigation, the EverGreen divestiture, the NovaMart acquisition, and the privacy compliance program) were opened earlier.
